description: Normal post-sale inquiry: product question followed by shipping question

turns.content: Hi, I just bought a SmartHome Camera. How long does the battery last?
The SmartHome Camera has a battery life of up to 6 months with motion detection enabled. It charges via USB-C and takes approximately 2-3 hours for a full charge.
Great! How long will it take to ship to me?
Standard domestic shipping takes 3-5 business days and is free for orders over $50. If you need it faster, express shipping (1-2 business days) is available for $9.99.

description: Troubleshooting escalation: device issue persists, escalate to human

turns.content: My SmartHome Lock won't turn on. I tried charging it but nothing happens.

I'm sorry to hear that. Please try these steps: 1) Connect the charger and wait at least 30 minutes. 2) Press and hold the power button for 10 seconds to force restart. 3) Try a different USB-C charging cable.
I tried all of that and it still doesn't work.

I understand this is frustrating. Since the basic troubleshooting steps haven't resolved the issue, this may require a warranty repair. Let me connect you with a specialist who can help arrange a repair or replacement under your warranty.
